{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Step 4: Check if treatment arm has both sexes
print('Treatment arm - sex distribution:')
print(df_treatment["sex"].value_counts())

# Step 5: Check severity distribution by sex in treatment arm
print('\nTreatment arm - severity by sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_treatment["sex"], df_treatment["severity"]))

# Step 6: Compute response rates by sex in treatment arm
response_rates = df_treatment.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rates by sex in treatment arm:')
print(response_rates)

# Step 7: Compute raw difference (in percentage points)
diff = response_rates['F'] - response_rates['M']
print(f'\nDifference in response rates (F - M): {diff:.3f} (i.e. {diff*100:.1f} percentage points)')"}
